---
title: Get All Vendors
description: List all vendor metadata entries with pagination.
api: "GET /api/vendors/"
---

Vendor metadata entries describe upstream model vendors. Model entries reference a vendor through `vendor_id`, and vendor fields such as the icon, data-retention window, and training opt-out flag are shown to end users on the pricing page.

Returns a paginated list of all vendors.

Requires **Admin** permissions. See [Authentication](/nookmux/api/management/auth) for how to authenticate management API requests.

## Request

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://your-nookmux-domain/api/vendors/?p=1&page_size=10' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'New-Api-User: 1'
```

</RequestExample>

### Query parameters

<ParamField path="p" type="integer" default="1">
  Page number.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="page_size" type="integer" default="10">
  Page size, capped at 100. The legacy aliases `ps` and `size` are also accepted.
</ParamField>

## Response

<ResponseExample>

```json 200
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "page": 1,
    "page_size": 10,
    "total": 2,
    "items": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "OpenAI",
        "description": "OpenAI models",
        "icon": "openai",
        "data_retention_days": 30,
        "training_opt_out": true,
        "status": 1,
        "created_time": 1735689600,
        "updated_time": 1735689600
      },
      {
        "id": 2,
        "name": "Anthropic",
        "icon": "anthropic",
        "status": 1,
        "created_time": 1735689700,
        "updated_time": 1735776000
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

</ResponseExample>

### Response fields

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean" required>
  Whether the request succeeded.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string" required>
  Error description when `success` is `false`; empty otherwise.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.page" type="integer" required>
  Current page number.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.page_size" type="integer" required>
  Page size actually applied.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.total" type="integer" required>
  Total number of vendors.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data.items" type="array" required>
  Vendor objects on the current page.

  <Expandable title="vendor structure">
    <ResponseField name="id" type="integer" required>
      Vendor ID.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="name" type="string" required>
      Vendor name, unique among non-deleted vendors; limited to 128 characters.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="description" type="string">
      Free-form description; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="icon" type="string">
      Icon name from `@lobehub/icons`, rendered by the frontend; limited to 128 characters; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="data_retention_days" type="integer">
      Data-retention window in days shown on the pricing page (`0` means no retention); omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="training_opt_out" type="boolean">
      Whether requests to this vendor are excluded from upstream model training by default (shown on the pricing page); omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="status" type="integer" required>
      Reserved status field; `1` means enabled.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="created_time" type="integer" required>
      Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, set by the server.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="updated_time" type="integer" required>
      Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, maintained by the server.
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<Note>
Management endpoints return HTTP `200` even on business failures; always check the `success` field.
</Note>

## Error messages

| Condition | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Database error, please try again later | Reading the vendor list or counting the total failed; see server logs |
